title: CONNECT-UDP Target Filtering Architecture
purpose: Define RFC 9298 vulnerable-target rejection and destination_ip_prohibited Proxy-Status reporting helpers.
design_summary: `Http3ConnectUdpTargetPolicy` classifies loopback, link-local, multicast, broadcast, unspecified, and caller-provided proxy-local addresses as prohibited UDP proxying destinations. It also creates the Proxy-Status field value carrying `destination_ip_prohibited` for rejected requests.
data_and_state_considerations: The policy is deterministic and does not enumerate host interfaces. Callers provide the proxy-local address set from their deployment/runtime context.
edge_cases_and_constraints: IPv4 and IPv6 loopback addresses are prohibited.
IPv4 and IPv6 link-local and multicast addresses are prohibited.
IPv4 broadcast and unspecified addresses are prohibited.
Proxy-owned addresses are prohibited when the caller provides them.
risks: Live DNS resolution and target filtering integration remain in the tunnel setup slice.
The helper does not make deployment-specific allow-list decisions.
